question_cn: 什么是底线杀（Back Rank Mate）？

options.text_cn: 王在棋盘中心被多个棋子围住将死
options.text_en: The king is checkmated in the center of the board by several pieces

options.text_cn: 王在底线（第1或第8横线）被车或后将死，且无法逃跑
options.text_en: The king is checkmated by a rook or queen on the first or eighth rank, with no escape

options.text_cn: 兵走到底线升变后立刻将死对方王
options.text_en: A pawn promotes on the last rank and immediately checkmates the enemy king

options.text_cn: 双车并列在底线同时将死对方王
options.text_en: Two rooks line up on the back rank and checkmate the enemy king together

explanation_cn: 底线杀指对方的王被困在底线（第1或第8横线），无法向前逃跑，被车或后沿底线将死。王通常被己方的兵封死，成为「杀王」的关键条件。
explanation_en: A back-rank mate occurs when the king is trapped on the first or eighth rank and a rook or queen checkmates it along that rank. The king's own pawns often block its escape squares, creating the key mating condition.
